title: 1f152 codepoint not found in any fonts on Windows
body:
### What Operating System(s) are you seeing this problem on?

Windows

### Which Wayland compositor or X11 Window manager(s) are you using?

_No response_

### WezTerm version

20230408-112425-69ae8472

### Did you try the latest nightly build to see if the issue is better (or worse!) than your current version?

Yes, and I updated the version box above to show the version of the nightly that I tried

### Describe the bug

Some characters cannot be displayed properly.
![1681736565792](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/95539012/232491962-bac5fee8-f4ef-48f1-b0bd-1da77659e38c.png)


### To Reproduce

1. Use conda to create a virtual environment
2. Switch to the environment

### Configuration

config.font = wezterm.font_with_fallback({ "Hack NFM", "Microsoft YaHei" })

### Expected Behavior

In other terminal, the character can be displayed properly.
![1681736542035](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/95539012/232491880-dbeddc2d-215a-4bc3-81cf-b61579c206a9.png)


### Logs

_No response_

### Anything else?

I used starship.

comments.body:

You didn't share them here so I don't know what they say.

The https://github.com/participant1/wezterm/issues/new?assignees=&labels=bug&template=bug.yml form has some information on locating the logs, please include them here.

I hope this helps! ![Screenshot 2023-10-23 at 00 23 19](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5394681/277229645-e637752d-1417-4467-8f08-305b4881d4ba.png)

Thanks for resolving. I can confirm this works on my Windows setup.

1) Downloaded font (e.g. [Link](https://github.com/zongren/font/blob/master/PingFang-SC-Regular.ttf))
2) Installed (double click on Windows)
3) Updated config `wezterm.lua`:

```lua
-- abbreviated example
return {
  font = wezterm.font_with_fallback {
    'JetBrainsMono NF',
    'Cascadia Code',
    'JetBrains Mono',
    -- added font
    'PingFang SC',
  },
}
```
4) Reload config and test with `conda activate <environment>`.
